# networkscaleup

The `networkscaleup` package provides a suite of functions to both fit
and diagnose the fit of several popular models for Aggregated Relational
Data (ARD). These models are fit using Stan (`RStan`) and `glmmTMB`.

## Installation

`networkscaleup` can be installed from CRAN with

``` r
install.packages("networkscaleup)
```

You can install the development version of `networkscaleup` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ilaga/networkscaleup")
```

## Simulating Data

The `networkscaleup` package allows simulation of synthetic ARD from
commonly used models.

``` r

## simulate some simple data
library(networkscaleup)

set.seed(2)
sim_dat <- make_ard(family = "poisson")
```

We can then fit the (true) model to this data and evaluate the fit of
this model. Several diagnostics are provided, including rootograms and
residual computation.

``` r

pois_fit_list <- fit_mle(sim_dat$ard, family = "poisson")

pois_root <- hang_rootogram_ard(
  ard = sim_dat$ard,
  model_fit = pois_fit_list
)

pois_root
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-3-1.png)

We see that the hanging rootogram indicates good fit, as would be
expected. More flexible models and additional model checking diagnostics
are also available.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`construct_pearson()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/construct_pearson.md)
  : Compute Pearson Residuals for ARD matrix and fitted model
- [`construct_rqr()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/construct_rqr.md)
  : Compute Randomized Quantile Residuals for ARD Models
- [`correlatedStan()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/correlatedStan.md)
  : Fit ARD using the uncorrelated or correlated model in Stan This
  function fits the ARD using either the uncorrelated or correlated
  model in Laga et al. (2021) in Stan. The population size estimates and
  degrees are scaled using a post-hoc procedure.
- [`cov_plots()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/cov_plots.md)
  : Covariance plots
- [`dispersion_metric()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/dispersion_metric.md)
  : Dispersion Metric for Fitted ARD Model
- [`example_data`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/example_data.md)
  : Simulated ARD data set with z and x.
- [`fit_mle()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/fit_mle.md)
  : Fit basic Poisson and Negative Binomial models using glmmTMB
- [`get_surrogate()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/get_surrogate.md)
  : Compute Surrogate Residuals for ARD Models
- [`hang_rootogram_ard()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/hang_rootogram_ard.md)
  : Hanging Rootogram for Fitted ARD Model
- [`killworth()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/killworth.md)
  : Fit Killworth models to ARD. This function estimates the degrees and
  population sizes using the plug-in MLE and MLE estimator.
- [`log_mix_uniform()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/log_mix_uniform.md)
  : log computed uniform quantile
- [`make_ard()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/make_ard.md)
  : Generate simulated ARD
- [`make_ard_tidy()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/make_ard_tidy.md)
  : Construct tibble from ARD matrix
- [`networkscaleup-package`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/networkscaleup.md)
  [`networkscaleup`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/networkscaleup.md)
  : The 'networkscaleup' package.
- [`overdispersed()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/overdispersed.md)
  : Fit Overdispersed model to ARD (Gibbs-Metropolis)
- [`overdispersedStan()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/overdispersedStan.md)
  : Fit ARD using the Overdispersed model in Stan
- [`plot_fitted()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/plot_fitted.md)
  : Plot residuals against fitted values
- [`residual_correlation()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/residual_correlation.md)
  : Construction Residual (row/column) correlation matrix
- [`residual_heatmap()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/residual_heatmap.md)
  : Construct heatmap of residuals
- [`rqr_nbinom_logs()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/rqr_nbinom_logs.md)
  : compute numerically stable negative binomial rqr
- [`rqr_pois_logs()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/rqr_pois_logs.md)
  : compute numerically stable Poisson rqr
- [`scaling()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/scaling.md)
  : Scale raw log degree and log prevalence estimates
- [`tw_group_corr_test()`](https://ilaga.github.io/networkscaleup/reference/tw_group_corr_test.md)
  : Tracy-Widom test for residual group correlation
